Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost by ~40% for your customer-facing features while preserving model quality and latency SLOs.
- Workloads discussed: chat assistant (avg seq 256, spikes to 2048), embeddings for semantic search (~200 requests/s), and nightly batch reranking jobs.
- Success criteria you called out: 99th pct latency under 200ms for interactive traffic, predictable monthly spend within a committed capacity, and SOC2 + data residency for EU customers.

Requested next steps:
1) Could you introduce the economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on committed capacity and procurement timelines?
2) If helpful, I can send a 1-page cost estimate + a draft SOW for procurement.
3) Lukas (cc) will follow up with a short technical note about compliance and integration hooks.

Happy to tailor the MAP to your timelines — do you have a preferred budget review date?
